responsibility: Implements allocation, reuse, resizing, insertion, and deletion of GIMPLE PHI nodes in SSA form. It maintains bucketed free lists for PHI-node recycling, constructs nodes sized to predecessor counts, manages arguments and abnormal-edge markings, removes arguments in sync with edge deletion, releases results, recognizes degenerate PHIs, and provides the concrete PHI storage management underlying SSA construction and CFG maintenance.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete PHI-node runtime support: allocation/reuse pools, sizing, insertion/removal, argument updates, and degenerate-PHI detection for SSA/CFG maintenance. Unlike gcc/tree-phinodes.h, which just exposes the API and small inline access helpers, this file implements the storage management and mutations.
